core_categories: Medical Supplies; Diagnostic Tools; Stethoscopes; Medical Disposables; Clinic Furniture
specialty_focus: Medisave UK is a medical supplier and distributor offering over 10,000 product lines to hospitals, GP surgeries, nursing homes, medical students, and private individuals. They specialize in diagnostic tools, custom-engraved stethoscopes, medical disposables, and clinic furniture. While they distribute some wearable-adjacent items like defibrillators, they are not primarily focused on wearable medical devices.
key_brands: 3M Littmann, Welch Allyn, Clinell, Keeler, Owen Mumford, Splicecast, Cell Path, others
